authorRole.en: Publisher of state-by-state vehicle tax, title, registration and inspection calculators

authorDesc.en: Radif Partners keeps one data file per state and for DC, read from each DMV or revenue department fee schedule and statute: the sales and use tax with county rates, title and plate fees, the registration formula (flat, weight, value, age or horsepower), value taxes, EV and hybrid surcharges, inspections and capped dealer fees. Each file records its source, the date it was read and a quotation, and the engine tests are replayed before any change goes live.
